front: leave a lasting impression on me
meaning: 给我留下持久而深刻的印象
example: The trip to Hainan left a lasting impression on me.
note: Part 2 结尾评价；重音：lasting impression

example: What impressed me most was the breathtaking coastline.
We could see the fish through the crystal-clear seawater.
A gentle sea breeze made the walk incredibly relaxing.
The holiday gave me a chance to recharge my batteries.
note: 自然口语表达，不是真的给电池充电

front: every meal was a real treat
example: The seafood was so fresh that every meal was a real treat.
note: a real treat = 很享受的体验

example: The locals were incredibly friendly and welcoming.
note: 描述当地人，避免只说 nice

example: My family and I have been looking forward to going back ever since.
note: look forward to 后接名词或 doing

example: What impressed me most was how peaceful the beach was.
note: Part 2 展开细节的自然句型

front: What made it even more memorable was…
example: What made it even more memorable was that it was a rare family trip.
The main reason is that it suits my long-term goals.
That said, prestige isn’t everything.
note: 让观点更平衡的让步句

example: It depends largely on a person’s priorities and circumstances.
From my perspective, practical experience is equally important.
There is no denying that technology makes learning more convenient.
note: 后面最好补充限制或例子

example: A good example would be online courses for people in remote areas.
note: 口语中比 for example 更灵活

example: In terms of convenience, online learning has a clear advantage.
note: 后接名词，不直接接完整句子

example: I agree with this view to some extent.
The most famous university is not necessarily the best choice.
Teachers play an important role in building students’ confidence.
Regular exercise has a positive impact on mental health.
Green spaces contribute to a better quality of life.
note: to 是介词，后接名词或 doing

example: Excessive screen time can lead to poor concentration.
note: 可用于正面或负面结果

example: Long working hours are often associated with stress.
note: 比 be related to 更学术

example: Speaking every day helped me build up my confidence.
note: build up 强调逐渐积累

example: Writing by hand may help students retain and process information.
I need to stop procrastinating and get on with my revision.

meaning: 一步一步给某人讲解某事
example: My teacher walked me through the speaking structure.
note: 适合描述老师或乐于助人的人

example: I made a small tweak to my study plan.
I find it difficult to organise my ideas under time constraints.
I follow a fairly tight revision schedule.
Children are often fascinated by sea creatures.
People make different choices depending on their circumstances.
I decided to take a different approach to revision.
I was quite inquisitive when I was a child.
I’m not really a thrill seeker, but I’d like to try kayaking.
note: thrill：舌尖轻触上齿，/θ/ 后立刻接 /r/
